    Why Pal Electronics ?

    All in one - Pal’s user-friendly APP enables to manage & control all your gates & doors from the same APP. Join more than 4 Million satisfied users!

    Installation - Plug & play devices which ensure a fast & clean installation.

    IoT - Our small wireless devices connect to any electric gate/door, lighting control or any place where saving time and remotely control and manage is an essence.

    Web portal – Time events, yearly calendar, installation status, time groups and many additional features makes it easy to all our chain of users: distributor-installer-end users to mange and control their device.
